deployment.answer: Docker for local development; Kubernetes or Weaviate Cloud for production.

config_ingestion.answer: Define each collection with a named vector from Configure.Vectors (configure.vectors in TypeScript, the Vectors map in Go v6); import objects with server-side batching.

code.python:
from weaviate.classes.config import Configure, Property, DataType

client.collections.create(
    "Article",
    vector_config=Configure.Vectors.text2vec_openai(),
    properties=[
        Property(name="title", data_type=DataType.TEXT),
        Property(name="body", data_type=DataType.TEXT),
    ],
)

collection = client.collections.use("Article")
with collection.batch.stream() as batch:
    for row in rows:
        batch.add_object(properties=row)

search.answer: Hybrid search as the starting point.

code.typescript:
const articles = client.collections.use('Article');
const result = await articles.query.hybrid('food', { limit: 3 })
